title: Demo · Cheating under the IPC, co-accused already on bail
story: Accused-1 is charged under IPC 420 and 406 for taking an advance of Rs. 6,50,000 for machinery that was never delivered; the offence (March 2024) predates the BNS, so the IPC governs. He has been in custody since 12.03.2024, the charge sheet was filed in time and the trial is under way; his earlier bail application was rejected, while Co-accused-2, with a comparable role, is on bail.

variant.offence: IPC 420/406 cheating (maximum 7 years), offence before 1 July 2024
variant.custody: default bail closed (charge sheet on day 55 of 60); past one-third of the maximum as a first-time offender (BNSS s.479 ELIGIBLE: 978 days against 852)
variant.parity: Co-accused-2 granted bail; first-time offender; earlier bail application rejected

steps.title: Rights Radar
steps.caption: At intake Peshkar ran the 7 rules of the Rights Radar on the dossier as of 2026-11-15: date arithmetic and statute tables, not the language model. Default bail: WINDOW_CLOSED, Undertrial limit (BNSS s.479): ELIGIBLE, Production within 24 hours: CHECK and Antil category: CHECK. Each result names its rule and the dates it used; rules not yet re-checked against the bare act are marked unverified.

filled.label: Default bail
filled.value: WINDOW_CLOSED: 60-day limit (maximum 7 years). Day 1 is the first remand, 13.03.2024. The charge sheet was filed on day 55 (06.05.2024). It came within the limit, so the right to default bail never arose.

filled.label: Undertrial limit (BNSS s.479)
filled.value: ELIGIBLE: 978 days in custody. The threshold is 852 days for a first-time offender (1/3 of 7 years, on bond) and 1,278 days otherwise (1/2, on bail). The applicable threshold (1/3, first-time offender) of 852 days has been reached. The record shows no other pending case (BNSS s.479(2)).

filled.value: UNKNOWN: Offence punishable up to 7 years. No arrest memo or notice in the file.

filled.label: Antil category
filled.value: CHECK: Category A (up to 7 years), unless treated as an economic offence (D). Antil's categories decide how an accused who was not arrested during investigation and cooperated is treated after the charge sheet; for a client in custody this is context, not a bail entitlement.

hi.title: Gate 2: आपका अनुमोदन
hi.caption: जब तक अधिवक्ता Gate 2 का अनुमोदन नहीं करता, निर्यात असंभव है: इस रन में अनुमोदन से पहले की गई निर्यात कॉल को अस्वीकार कर दिया गया था (403)। चेकलिस्ट में अधिवक्ता के लिए 13 मदें हैं (13 UNANSWERED आपत्तियां); अनुमोदन यह दर्ज करता है कि अधिवक्ता ने उन्हें पढ़ लिया है। इसके बाद अधिवक्ता के रूप में Gate 2 का अनुमोदन करता है।

hi.title: डेमो · IPC के तहत धोखाधड़ी, सह-अभुयुक्त पहले से जमानत पर
hi.story: Accused-1 पर मशीनरी के लिए 6,50,000 रुपये का अग्रिम भुगतान लेकर उसकी डिलीवरी न करने के संबंध में IPC 420 और 406 के तहत आरोप हैं; अपराध (मार्च 2024) BNS लागू होने से पहले का है, इसलिए IPC लागू होता है। वह 12.03.2024 से हिरासत में हैं, आरोप-पत्र समय पर दाखिल किया गया था और विचारण जारी है; उनका पिछला जमानत आवेदन खारिज कर दिया गया था, जबकि समान भूमिका वाले Co-accused-2 जमानत पर हैं।
